title: Python Core Refresher
description: A hands-on session to regain fluency with Python syntax and essential features.

python-fundamentals-001.title: Essential values
python-fundamentals-001.objective: Reactivate assignment syntax and fundamental types.
python-fundamentals-001.description: Create variables named nome, idade, altura, ativo, and observacao for a name, age, height, active status, and a note with no value. Print each value together with its type.
requirements: Use str, int, float, bool, and None
Use type() when printing the types

python-fundamentals-002.title: Operators in action
python-fundamentals-002.topic: Arithmetic, comparison, logical, identity, and membership operators
python-fundamentals-002.objective: Review the main operator families in a short snippet.
python-fundamentals-002.description: Given a = 14, b = 5, numeros = [5, 10, 14], and valor = None, calculate floor division and remainder. Then print expressions using comparisons, and/or/not, in, and is None.
requirements: Use at least one logical operator
python-fundamentals-002.example_output:
floor division: 2
remainder: 4
comparison: True
logic: True
membership: True
identity: True

python-strings-001.title: Text slices
python-strings-001.objective: Recall positive and negative indexes and slices.
python-strings-001.description: Using the existing texto string, print the first character, the last one, characters from index 1 through 4, and the reversed word.

python-strings-002.title: Clean and rebuild
python-strings-002.objective: Review the method chain commonly used in text processing.
python-strings-002.description: Normalize the string '  Go,Python,Rust  ': remove outer spaces, replace Go with C, split on commas, and join the items with ' | '.
requirements: Use strip(), replace(), split(), and join()

python-strings-003.title: Formatted summary
python-strings-003.objective: Practice explicit conversion and numeric formatting.
python-strings-003.description: Convert preco_texto and quantidade to numbers, calculate the total, and print an f-string with produto in uppercase and the total with two decimal places.
requirements: Format the total with two decimal places

python-lists-001.title: List mutation
python-lists-001.topic: append, extend, insert, remove, and pop
python-lists-001.objective: Recall the most frequent mutable list operations.
python-lists-001.description: Starting with numeros = [2, 3], insert 1 at the beginning, append 4, extend with 5 and 6, remove 3, and pop the last item. Store the popped item in ultimo and print both values.
requirements: Use insert, append, extend, remove, and pop
At the end, numbers must be [1, 2, 4, 5]

python-lists-002.title: Sort without losing the original
python-lists-002.objective: Distinguish operations that return a collection from those that mutate it.
python-lists-002.description: Create a sorted version of valores without changing the original. Then sort valores in place in descending order and print a copy of its first three items.
requirements: Use sorted() for the first version
Use slicing for the first three items

python-tuples-001.title: Flexible unpacking
python-tuples-001.objective: Review tuples, unpacking, and capturing middle values.
python-tuples-001.description: Unpack the tuple ('Ana', 31, 'Recife', 'PE') into name, age, and a remaining variable containing city and state. Swap name and age in one assignment and print everything.
requirements: Do not try to mutate the tuple

python-dicts-001.title: Dictionary record
python-dicts-001.objective: Review the basic dict manipulation cycle.
python-dicts-001.description: In the usuario dictionary, update idade, add the cidade key, read email with get using 'não informado' as the default, and remove ativo with pop.
requirements: Use get with a default value
Use pop and store the removed value

python-dicts-002.title: Three views of a dict
python-dicts-002.objective: Regain familiarity with dictionary views and pair iteration.
python-dicts-002.description: Print the keys and values of estoque separately. Then iterate over the pairs and print lines such as 'caneta: 12'.
requirements: Unpack key and value in the for loop

python-sets-001.title: Skill sets
python-sets-001.description: Convert both skill lists to sets and show all unique skills, common skills, and skills exclusive to the first person.

python-flow-001.title: Range and label
python-flow-001.topic: if, elif, else, and conditional expressions
python-flow-001.objective: Review branching and compact conditional expressions.
python-flow-001.description: Classify nota as 'excelente' (>= 9), 'aprovado' (>= 7), or 'revisar'. In another variable, use a conditional expression to produce 'par' or 'ímpar' for numero.

python-flow-002.title: Dispatch with match
python-flow-002.description: Create classificar_status(codigo) with match/case: 200 returns 'ok'; 400 or 404 returns 'erro do cliente'; 500 returns 'erro do servidor'; anything else returns 'desconhecido'.

python-loops-001.title: Human-friendly indexes
python-loops-001.objective: Review iteration with numeric sequences and indexes.
python-loops-001.description: Print the squares from 1 through 5 using range. Then enumerate the languages starting at 1 in the format '1. Python'.

python-loops-002.title: Parallel traversal
python-loops-002.objective: Recall how to traverse collections in parallel.
python-loops-002.description: Traverse names and ages together and print sentences such as 'Lia is 29 years old'. Then create a dictionary by combining both lists.
requirements: Unpack values in the for loop
Create the dict without manual indexes
python-loops-002.example_output:
Lia is 29 years old
Rui is 34 years old
Caio is 26 years old
{'Lia': 29, 'Rui': 34, 'Caio': 26}

python-loops-003.title: Controlled search
python-loops-003.topic: while, break, continue, and loop else
python-loops-003.objective: Review explicit repetition control and the loop else clause.
python-loops-003.description: With contador from 0 to 9, skip even numbers with continue, search for alvo 7, and stop with break. Use else on the loop to print 'não encontrado' if the target is absent.
requirements: Include an else clause on the while loop

python-comprehensions-001.title: Even squares
python-comprehensions-001.objective: Review transformation and filtering in one expression.
python-comprehensions-001.description: Given numeros, produce quadrados_pares containing the square of only the even numbers.
requirements: Do not use an explicit for loop

python-comprehensions-002.title: Compact mappings and sets
python-comprehensions-002.objective: Practice comprehensions with other collection types.
python-comprehensions-002.description: Create a dictionary mapping each word to its length, only for words with at least 5 letters. Also create a set containing the uppercase first letters.
requirements: Use a dict comprehension with a filter

python-functions-001.title: Configurable greeting
python-functions-001.objective: Review definitions, returns, defaults, and keyword calls.
python-functions-001.description: Create saudacao(nome, prefixo='Olá') returning a formatted sentence. Call it once with only nome and once using prefixo as a keyword argument.
requirements: Make a call with a keyword argument

python-functions-002.title: Variable arguments
python-functions-002.objective: Reactivate positional and keyword argument capture.
python-functions-002.description: Create somar(*args), which returns the sum, and descrever(**kwargs), which returns a list of 'key=value' strings sorted by key.

python-functions-003.title: Two results and scope
python-functions-003.objective: Review tuple returns and scope rules.
python-functions-003.description: Create limites(valores), returning minimum and maximum for unpacking. Then create fabrica_contador() with a local variable and an inner function that uses nonlocal to increment it.
requirements: Use nonlocal in the inner function

python-functions-004.title: Functions as data
python-functions-004.objective: Review functions as objects and basic functional operations.
python-functions-004.description: Store a doubling lambda in a variable. Use filter to keep positive values and map to double them. Convert the final result to a list.

python-iteration-001.title: Under the for loop
python-iteration-001.description: Get an iterator from the cores list with iter(), consume three values with next(), and handle StopIteration when trying to read a fourth value.
python-iteration-001.example_output:
azul
verde
âmbar
end of iterator

python-iteration-002.title: Countdown generator
python-iteration-002.objective: Review lazy value creation and consumption.
python-iteration-002.description: Create contagem_regressiva(inicio), a generator that yields numbers down to 1 and then the string 'já'. Demonstrate consuming it in a for loop.
requirements: Do not build a list inside the function
Update the counter after each yield

python-errors-001.title: Protected conversion
python-errors-001.topic: try, multiple except clauses, else, and finally
python-errors-001.description: Create dividir(texto_a, texto_b). Convert the strings and divide, handle ValueError and ZeroDivisionError separately, return the result in else, and print 'fim' in finally.

python-errors-002.title: Domain error
python-errors-002.objective: Review how to express domain-specific failures.
python-errors-002.description: Create SaldoInsuficiente inheriting from Exception and a sacar(saldo, valor) function. Raise the exception if valor exceeds saldo; otherwise return the new balance.
requirements: Include balance and amount in the message
python-errors-002.example_output:
new balance: 65
Saldo insuficiente: saldo=10, valor=20

python-files-001.title: Temporary journal
python-files-001.topic: open, with, writing, appending, and reading
python-files-001.objective: Review the safe text-file manipulation cycle.
python-files-001.description: Create notes.txt with two lines using with and write mode. Open it again in append mode, add one line, then read and print the complete contents.
requirements: Use w, a, and r modes
python-files-001.example_output:
first note
second note
third note

python-files-002.title: Modern paths
python-files-002.description: With pathlib.Path, create the data folder, write 'Python\nGo\n' to languages.txt, read it, and print its name, suffix, and lines.
requirements: Use write_text and read_text with UTF-8

python-modules-001.title: Imports and entry point
python-modules-001.objective: Review import styles and entry-point protection.
python-modules-001.description: Import PI from constantes.py with an alias and import area_circulo. Create main() that prints the area for radius 2 and call it only under if __name__ == '__main__'.
requirements: Use from ... import with an alias

python-oop-001.title: Accounts in motion
python-oop-001.objective: Review the minimum structure of a useful class.
python-oop-001.description: Create Conta with titular and an initial saldo of zero. Implement depositar(valor), which changes and returns saldo. Instantiate two accounts and make different deposits.
requirements: Use self in attributes and methods

python-oop-002.title: User factory
python-oop-002.objective: Distinguish class state from utilities associated with the class.
python-oop-002.description: Create Usuario with the class attribute total = 0. Increment it in __init__, implement from_email(cls, email) using the part before @ as nome, and add an email_valido(email) static method.

python-oop-003.title: Controlled temperature
python-oop-003.objective: Review internal attributes and validated properties.
python-oop-003.description: Create Temperatura storing _celsius. Expose celsius with @property and a setter; reject values below -273.15 with ValueError. Add a read-only fahrenheit property.

python-oop-004.title: Specialization with super
python-oop-004.description: Create Animal with nome and falar(). Create Cachorro(Animal), call super().__init__, override falar to return 'au', and add apresentar using the inherited nome.

python-oop-005.title: Order through composition
python-oop-005.objective: Recall composition as an alternative to inheritance.
python-oop-005.description: Create Item(nome, preco) and Pedido(itens). Pedido must receive items, support adicionar(item), and calculate total() by summing precos.
requirements: Use append in the add method
Use sum in the total method

python-oop-006.title: Objects that speak Python
python-oop-006.objective: Review special methods that integrate objects with built-ins.
python-oop-006.description: Create Produto(nome, preco, tags). Make str show 'nome — R$ preco', repr return recreatable code, equality compare nome and preco, and len return the number of tags.
requirements: Return NotImplemented from __eq__ for another type
Format the price with two decimal places

python-structures-001.title: Declarative data
python-structures-001.objective: Review two standard structures for simple modeling.
python-structures-001.description: Create Status(Enum) with PENDENTE and CONCLUIDO. Create the Tarefa dataclass with titulo, a default status of PENDENTE, and tags using default_factory=list.

python-language-001.title: Call decorator
python-language-001.objective: Review nested functions and controlled function replacement.
python-language-001.description: Create @registrar that prints the function name before calling it and preserves metadata with wraps. Apply it to multiplicar(a, b).

python-language-002.title: Your own context
python-language-002.objective: Review the protocol used by the with statement.
python-language-002.description: Create Temporizador with __enter__ and __exit__. On entry, store time.perf_counter(); on exit, print the elapsed time. Use it in a with block.

python-language-003.title: Lightweight contracts
python-language-003.objective: Reactivate common annotations without confusing them with automatic validation.
python-language-003.description: Create media(valores: list[float]) -> float. Use isinstance to require a list, reject other types with TypeError, and show the difference between type(x) is int and isinstance(x, int) using True.
python-language-003.example_output:
average: 7.5
type(True) is int: False
isinstance(True, int): True

python-language-004.title: Capture and advanced slices
python-language-004.objective: Review assignment expressions and slices with a step.
python-language-004.description: Use := inside an if to store the length of dados and print it when there are at least 5 items. Then get even-indexed items in reverse order with one slice.
requirements: Use a slice with a negative step

python-builtins-001.title: Native toolbox
python-builtins-001.topic: len, sum, min, max, sorted, reversed, any, and all
python-builtins-001.objective: Recall built-ins that replace common manual loops.
python-builtins-001.description: For valores, store quantidade, total, menor, maior, crescente, and inversa. Also store tem_negativo and todos_inteiros.
requirements: Use generator expressions with any and all
python-builtins-001.example_output:
count: 5
total: 25
minimum/maximum: -2 11
ascending: [-2, 3, 5, 8, 11]
reverse: [3, 11, 5, -2, 8]
True
True

python-stdlib-001.title: Batteries-included numbers
python-stdlib-001.objective: Review numeric operations and reproducible randomness.
python-stdlib-001.description: Use math to calculate the square root of 81, ceiling of 4.2, and factorial of 5. Use a local random.Random(42) to draw an integer from 1 to 10 and choose a color.
requirements: Use Random with a seed without changing global state
python-stdlib-001.example_output:
root: 9.0
ceiling: 5
factorial: 120
draw: 2
color: blue

python-stdlib-002.title: Serialized dates
python-stdlib-002.objective: Review dates, deltas, and JSON serialization.
python-stdlib-002.description: Create the date 2025-01-15, add 30 days, and build dados with inicio and fim in ISO format. Serialize it to texto_json with json.dumps and restore it to recuperado with json.loads.

python-stdlib-003.title: Counting and grouping
python-stdlib-003.objective: Regain familiarity with three useful specialized collections.
python-stdlib-003.description: Count the words with Counter and show the two most common. Group words by first letter with defaultdict(list). Use deque to add 'zero' on the left and remove the last item.
requirements: Use appendleft and pop on deque

python-stdlib-004.title: Lazy pipeline
python-stdlib-004.description: Use itertools.chain to join both lists, materialize the first five values with islice in primeiros, and use functools.reduce to store their product in produto.
requirements: Materialize the five values only once
